# Synapse Network

Synapse Network is an agent-first settlement layer for AI agents. The primary product goal is: agent completed first paid invocation autonomously.

## Start Here

- docs/AGENTS.md - canonical workspace rules, product doctrine, architecture invariants, security baseline, and instruction layering
- docs/00_Governance/README.md - documentation lifecycle, ownership, drift prevention, and agent-docs migration governance
- docs/00_Governance/Documentation_Constraints.md - hard boundaries for root docs, canonical placement, retired paths, and docs gate enforcement
- docs/00_Governance/Documentation_Inventory.md - review inventory for root entrypoints, governance docs, canonical owners, and freshness cadence
- docs/reference/Agent_Task_Map.md - task-to-file routing map for AI agents
- docs/reference/Agent_Task_Map.json - machine-readable domain map for agent workflow tools
- docs/README.md - full documentation map and recommended reading order
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md - top-level architecture summary across runtime, settlement, control plane, and provider systems
- docs/plans/README.md - current planning bundle entrypoint for active implementation work
- docs/ops/10_Production_Go_No_Go_Security_Verification.md - production launch Go/No-Go gate for contracts, finance, gateway, monitoring, recovery, and sign-off
- docs/ops/11_Performance_and_Reliability_Verification.md - performance, load, chaos, rollback, and local reliability smoke verification plan
- docs/ops/12_Gateway_Pre_Launch_Stress_Review.md - executable gateway stress-review constraints for fake async, timeouts, DB transactions, OOM, and indexes
- docs/ops/13_Production_Monitoring_Alerting_and_Backup_Restore.md - production monitoring, alerting, and backup restore evidence gate
- docs/ops/14_Gmail_Email_Notifications.md - async Gmail SMTP notification outbox, quotas, and delivery semantics
- docs/ops/15_Google_Cloud_Launch_Readiness.md - Google Cloud staging/prod readiness, Terraform bootstrap, and production blockers
- docs/ops/16_Arbitrum_Sepolia_Staging_Contracts.md - Arbitrum Sepolia staging deployment, MockUSDC pre-mint, Arbiscan verification, and contract evidence gates
- docs/ops/17_Staging_Environment_Configuration.md - staging DNS, Cloud Run env, Secret Manager, Gmail, Lark, and Arbitrum Sepolia configuration checklist
- docs/ops/17_In_App_Notifications.md - self-hosted Postgres inbox, after-commit notification writes, TTL cleanup, and User-front smart polling
- docs/ops/18_Staging_Validation_Runbook.md - staging smoke, core money-path validation, notification evidence, and first-phase acceptance checklist
- docs/ops/19_E2E_Regression_Runbook.md - canonical local/staging E2E regression matrix with read-only SQL evidence for owner, provider, deposit, invoke, withdrawal, notification, analytics, and contract state
- docs/security/README.md - internal security evidence entrypoint, including SynapseCore internal audit, closure log, and risk acceptance

## AI-Oriented References

- AGENTS.md - unified Codex, Cursor, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot instruction bridge for routing into the shared rule stack
- docs/reference/Agent_Task_Map.md - human-readable agent task routing map
- docs/reference/Agent_Task_Map.json - machine-readable agent task routing map

- .github/instructions/README.md - routing manifest for Python, frontend, finance, docs-sync, admin-console, and safety instructions
- docs/reference/AI_Instruction_Entrypoints.md - agent-specific entrypoint map and bridge drift policy
- docs/06_Reference/AI_Quick_Reference.md - compressed repository facts for agents
- docs/reference/Validation_Entry_Points.md - current validation commands and workflow checks
- docs/ops/19_E2E_Regression_Runbook.md - local/staging regression runbook; API/UI E2E is not complete until the SQL evidence layer proves Postgres state, balances, ledger, audit, outbox, and contract config are correct
- E2E service fixtures default to canonical provider services (`svc_oss_security_healthcheck`, `svc_web3_sentiment_index`, `svc_protocol_fundamental_brief`); random service creation requires explicit opt-in and cleanup.
- npm run ci:docs - lightweight docs governance gate for root growth, retired-path regressions, and canonical metadata minimums
- npm run ci:performance-reliability - local performance/reliability smoke for provider health probe concurrency and slow lane guardrails
- npm run perf:local-production-load-rehearsal && npm run ci:local-production-load-evidence - local MVP load rehearsal with temporary wallet isolation, bounded concurrency, graceful drain, and redacted evidence
- npm run ci:gateway-stress-review - static gateway pre-launch scan for fake async, missing timeouts, transaction wait, unbounded reads, and hot-path indexes
- docs/00_Governance/Agent_Docs_Migration_Map.md - historical map for the retired agent-doc layer and its merge into official modules
- docs/00_Governance/exec-plans/README.md - plan structure for active and completed work
- docs/plans/production-go-live-security-verification/README.md - executable evidence plan for production launch approval
- docs/security/SynapseCore_Internal_Production_Security_Audit_Report.md - internal SynapseCore production security audit report
- docs/security/SynapseCore_Internal_Audit_Closure_Log.md - internal audit finding closure log
- docs/security/SynapseCore_Internal_Audit_Risk_Acceptance.md - no-third-party-audit risk acceptance for capped MVP production
- docs/security/SynapseCore_Production_Audit_Verification_Report.md - production-grade verification report for the internal audit evidence package

## Important Boundaries

- gateway is the runtime and settlement chain-offload control point
- contracts is the on-chain vault and settlement boundary
- gateway-admin is the admin control-plane backend, not a second runtime gateway
- admin-front is the admin control-plane UI
- provider_service is a provider runtime sample, not a settlement service
- frontend is the owner and developer facing product console
- docs-front is the dedicated developer documentation project at docs.synapse-network.ai and owns public docs SEO/AI assets

## Finance-Sensitive Work

For any money movement, settlement, approval, withdrawal review, refund, or reconciliation change, always read:

- docs/AGENTS.md
- .github/instructions/finance-backend.instructions.md
- .github/instructions/finance-admin.instructions.md when the task touches admin finance control-plane flows

## Validation Anchors

- root CI wrappers live in package.json under ci:* scripts
- project-local validation commands are summarized in docs/reference/Validation_Entry_Points.md
- production launch additionally requires the evidence bundle in docs/plans/production-go-live-security-verification/validation.md and the security evidence under docs/security/

## Planning

- use docs/00_Governance/exec-plans/templates/Exec_Plan_Template.md for new multi-step work
- store in-progress work under docs/00_Governance/exec-plans/active/
- move finished plans to docs/00_Governance/exec-plans/completed/
- docs/plan/README.md is a legacy archive entrypoint, not the canonical planning workspace
- docs/plan/项目计划.md is a historical product-growth memo, not a standardized execution plan
